In Professor Catlove's routine, cats exhibit classical conditioning: can opening (CS) paired with food (US) elicits running, purring (CR). Operant conditioning reinforces meowing, rubbing via food rewards. Social learning occurs as cats imitate peers. Professor shows operant conditioning, affection reinforcing can-opening.

(50 words)
